Openweight workhorse belt for heavy strikers.

How NEVER Openweight Championship connects

  • Character: Shingo Takagi — Shingo's New Japan rise ran through the NEVER Openweight Championship.

What is NEVER Openweight Championship?

The NEVER Openweight Championship is New Japan's openweight midcard title, a belt Shingo Takagi and other heavy hitters used as a stepping stone toward IWGP gold.

Key threads lead to Shingo Takagi.
